text:
Devon (oncall): incident-bot alerted at ~08:12 UTC — high error rate on /v1/generate for hosted region-us-east-1. Seeing ~40% 5xxs, latency spikes to 3-6s. Paging SRE now. Please coordinate customer comms.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INC-2026-041 — alert triggered: route=/v1/generate, service=hosted-runtime, region=us-east-1, severity=sev2
Sam (SRE): I’m on it. Initial look — a batcher regression + a kernel fallback thrash on certain quantized models. Rolling a temporary route-based fallback to older model shard to stop the spike. ETA for mitigation ~10-12m. Pushing a canary policy now.
Devon (oncall): thanks. @Sam please paste the mitigation steps and the customer-facing summary here once stable. I’ll start a draft email for affected customers and update the status page.
Sam (SRE): Mitigation applied: updated routing policy to prefer model-variant v1.8 (non-quantized) for region-us-east-1; limited max-batch-size to 8; disabled continuous batching spike heuristic. Immediate effect: error rate down to ~3% in last 3m, p50 latency back to ~120ms. Will monitor for 30m.
Maria (CS): tagging in — which customers saw errors? I can query usage and surface a prioritized list (top-10 by 24h tokens). Need to know potential SLA credit scope.
Sam (SRE): Quick list (top affected): AcmePayments, AtlasChat, KiddoEd. I’ll export logs and send to @Maria privately. Root cause: regression in batching heuristic interacting with quantized-kernel fallback leading to failed kernel selection under concurrency.
Devon (oncall): Good. @Maria draft should say: brief incident summary, customer impact (failed requests and slow responses), timeframe, mitigation, follow-up RCA + compensatory offer if applicable. Keep tone apologetic, factual, and actionable.
Maria (CS): Drafting. Posting proposed customer note below (feedback welcome):

---
Hi <CustomerName> :wave:

We wanted to let you know about an incident that affected requests to our text generation API in region us-east-1 today from 08:12–08:38 UTC.

What happened
• Between ~08:12 and ~08:38 UTC some requests experienced increased errors (up to ~40% at peak) and slower responses. The issue was caused by a batching heuristic interacting poorly with a fallback path for quantized models, which led to kernel selection failures under concurrency.

What we did
• At ~08:24 UTC we applied a routing fallback to a non-quantized model variant and adjusted batching limits. This reduced errors to normal levels within ~5–10 minutes. We continued monitoring until 08:38 UTC and confirmed stability.

What this means for you
• Some requests during the window may have failed or timed out. We will provide a CSV of affected API keys and counts if you’d like. If this incident caused a material outage to your product and you are eligible for a SLA credit, we will follow up with our account team.

Next steps
• We will publish a full RCA and timeline within 72 hours. Action items include reverting the regression in the batching heuristic, adding additional kernel-selection checks, and expanding our integration tests for quantized model paths.

If you’d like a private sync, please reply and we’ll set one up with engineering and your account team.

Apologies for the disruption — we know this impacts your users and we’re prioritizing follow-through. :heart:

— Maria on behalf of Redwood Inference
---

Maria (CS): thoughts? Should we offer an immediate small credit (e.g., 5%) to all affected customers or reserve credits for material impact only?
Alice (Product): lean conservative — reserve formal SLA credits for material customer impact. Offer a goodwill gesture (1–3% credit) proactively to top affected customers and escalate others case-by-case. Also propose a short FAQ snippet for the status page.
Devon (oncall): Agree with Alice. @Maria — add a line offering a small goodwill credit to top-affected customers and route others to their account rep. Keep the email template above.
Sam (SRE): I’ll attach a short technical appendix for customers who ask, and the internal RCA will include the exact logs and PR that introduced regression. Quick appendix (for engineering-savvy customers):

```
Timeline (UTC):
08:11:41 - batcher heuristic A toggles new path
08:12:03 - first elevated 5xx observed
08:23:50 - error spike confirmed, paging SRE
08:24:18 - routing fallback to model v1.8 applied
08:30:00 - error rate <4%
08:38:00 - continued monitoring; stable

Root cause: heuristic A caused incompatible concurrency assumptions with quantized kernel-selector v2.4 -> kernel lookup failures under high concurrency.
Fix: revert heuristic A, add kernel-selector fallback and unit/integration tests for quantized paths.
```

Maria (CS): thanks — I’ll include a short "tech appendix" link for anyone who wants the details.
Devon (oncall): Status page update suggestion (short):

- Incident: Elevated errors on /v1/generate (us-east-1)
- Start: 2026-04-12 08:12 UTC
- Mitigation: routing fallback to alternate model variant + batching limit (08:24 UTC)
- Resolution: service stability confirmed (08:38 UTC)
- Next update: Full RCA within 72 hours

Maria (CS): I'll post that to status.redwood (we have a templated component). Anyone want to review before I publish? @Alice @Sam
Alice (Product): LGTM, maybe soften the technical language a bit for status page. Replace "non-quantized" with "alternate model variant" on public page.
Sam (SRE): agreed to soften.
Maria (CS): publishing in 2m. Drafting email to top-affected customers now. Will cc account execs and include CSV if they request it.
ops-bot: Link to deploys and PR: https://git.redwood/infer/commit/9a7c2b3 (PR #2746) — flagged for revert.
Devon (oncall): handoff: I need to wrap on-call at 09:00 UTC. @Sam please stay on watch for the next 30m and I'll coordinate the post-incident Slack channel for the RCA. @Maria you own initial customer notifications + status page. I'll add action items to the incident tracker.
Sam (SRE): staying on watch. Will run extra smoke tests for quantized paths and schedule the revert PR for immediate review.
Maria (CS): Email to top-affected customers sent (08:44 UTC). Status page updated (08:46 UTC). Copy of email saved to incident folder.
Devon (oncall): thanks team. Action items (brief):
- Sam: revert PR + tests (due EOD)
- Sam: paste logs for top customers to secure folder (done by 12:00 UTC)
- Maria: customer follow-up tracker + goodwill credits for top-3 (send by EOD)
- Alice: coordinate product comms + FAQ update (by EOD)
- Devon: write internal RCA skeleton and handoff to Sam and Research for deep-dive (within 24h)

Sam (SRE): noted. I’ll post the initial RCA draft in #incidents within 24h. 
Devon (oncall): final handoff — I'm offcall now. @Sam you're primary. Ping me if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
Maria (CS): will follow up with account execs and share the customer list + CSV. Thanks all. :heart:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-041 status -> mitigated -> monitoring
